title: Peleliu: Rakuen no Guernica
titleNative: ペリリュー～楽園のゲルニカ～
synopsis: Peleliu - Rakuen no Guernica follows the daily lives of Japanese soldiers taking part in the Battle of Peleliu during World War II: a high-casualty, months-long campaign. The main character, Tamaru, dreams of returning home to become a mangaka, and sees their island outpost as a wild paradise that can one day be used as a setting for one of his stories. Most of his comrades, however, are prepared for the more realistic scenario -- that they will not be leaving Peleliu alive. Note: Nominated to the 25th Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize.

synonyms: In My Death, I Became My Brother's Regret
synopsis: When Jing Mo showed demonic powers that was latent in his blood, his brother Jueming was forced to kill him. Jing Mo woke up to find himself reincarnated into the body of the boy Bai Zhu, but there seems to be something… strange about this body, too. Jing Mo wants to run away and hide his identity, but Jueming wants to find his brother's missing body and wouldn't let him go. One wants to hide, the other wants to find the truth, as they become embroiled in a deadly struggle over Bai Zhu's true nature. (Source: Bilibili, translated) Note: Chapter count includes 10 extra chapters.

titleRomaji: Henkyougurashi no Maou, Tensei shite Saikyou no Majutsushi ni Naru
titleNative: 辺境ぐらしの魔王、転生して最強の魔術師になる
synonyms: The Demon King of the Frontier Life, Reincarnated To Become the Strongest Mage ~The Former Demon King Who Grows up While Being Loved, Wants To Know Humans~
synopsis: There was a mage called "The Lone Demon King" at the frontier. He was just a creature that never grew old, but he was loved by the villagers as something of a guardian deity. However, he was destroyed by a magic organization that sees his existence as dangerous. 200 years later, he is reincarnated as the second son of an aristocrat and obtains the strongest magic power. "Let's pretend to be a human this time..." However, being a human lover, he didn't particularly think of revenge and has decided to pretend to be human in this life. In his past life, he was the guardian deity of a region, and in this life, he's a local aristocrat, but he does not know common sense. He doesn't know how to take it easy. As the second son of an aristocrat, he is loved by his family and friends, and while he is regarded as a master of magic in the magic guild, he becomes an "Immortal Mage" behind the scenes. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)
